notes.title: The Big Update (1.08)
notes.notes:
Hey folks! This is easily the biggest update you've ever seen for Choice Chamber. We've gone ahead and added in every last outstanding thing that was dreamed up during the Kickstarter. New weapons, gizmos, enemies, bosses, power ups, polls, trolls, achievements, and more await you in the chambers.

We've also added a way for you to gain extra powers from the chat room. If you subscribe to Bean's Twitch channel, you can use special commands in any channel playing the game. It's a great way to support the developer and get something in return, especially if you like playing along with other broadcasters. More info here.

Without further ado, the changelog!
- added 3 weapons
- added 4 bosses
- added 3 gizmos
- added rainbow heart
- added sub powers (more info)
- added new special event
- added new achievements
- added new polls
- added highscore saving for ball bounces
- added weapon display to first room
- added trophy room
- added confetti to chests and boss deaths (so magical)
- changed room captain gifts to appear in next room if they didn't land yet
- changed special events to appear at start when unlocked
- chiseled out Heroes
- added more dynamic sounds to weapons (miss, hit, etc)
- fixed Max+pogo / character+wing jumping when walking off ledge / attacking
- fixed gameover sending you to weird black abyss
- fixed title screen taking menu input on first farme
- fixed Starnose not fully turning red when damaged
- fixed lift gizmo gaining momentum during cutscene
- fixed toothy/ferret staying frozen when dead
- fixed player 2 gizmo unable to move in warpzone

Sweet art by @jouste, developer on Viking Squad. Click for full image!

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.notes:
A small update went out for Choice Chamber today, mostly in response to Twitch moving over their chat servers. They're slowly transitioning all channels, so the game now handles both the old and new connection methods. If your game suddenly stopped connecting in the past few weeks, it might work now!

Also, we added a "reset connections" button to the settings window for when your Chat Bot can't connect anymore, or your game is stuck trying to connect in general. This will erase your connection data so you can enter it in from scratch, hopefully fixing any weird loopholes.

We're working on a big content update for the nearish future, so thanks for your patience! ♥

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the feedback for Race Mode beta! Below are a few changes and additions to help make online races a bit more possible. We're not sure why people were getting global banned on Twitch, as the game sends messages at a slow enough rate. We've made it even slower now, meaning your online opponent will update less often. Hopefully this helps out!

Changelog
- Added background to race title
- Reduced netcode speed to prevent global banning from Twitch (oops)
- Increased time it takes to be considered disconnected
- Added visual cue to power blocks
- Increased liklihood of power blocks appearing
- Increased amount of times special chunks appear

notes.title: Race Mode Beta! Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks for your patience between updates. We've been working hard on the new race mode, allowing you to compete against other players both locally and online! Race mode is now in the game, but is still in beta, so please be sure to leave feedback in the forums if you come across something that ain't quite right.

Changelog:
- Added Race Mode (currently in beta, FAQ here)
- Added 18 usernames for Backer Powers & Credits
- Fixed ability to get POGOORNOGO achievement
- Added ability to open Room Captain gifts in Warp Zone
- Changed Hoarfrosted enemies to only be frozen for 1 minute
- Fixed issue when being lifted while exit door cutscene plays
- Fixed particle waterfall when destroying Shop tube glass after buying something
- Fixed placement of flying loot in Grid Room
- Fixed Lucky being able to run off screen in final area
- Fixed solo AI for Great Gizmo to actually shoot at stuff
- Fixed unlocking things at Game Over screen if a Gizmo kills the boss
- Improved accuracy of Laser against environmental objects
- Changed power of Room Captain bomb
- Fixed Studio Bean logo sometimes playing out of sync

notes.title: Patch 1.02 [updated]
notes.notes:
update!
Made a few quick fixes from last time:
- fixed player getting sent to top of room when riding a Statue into ceiling
- Gizmos are no longer for sale in shop when player is maxed out
- fixed player getting killed on final frame before Warp Zone
- fixed Great Gizmos spawning multiple times across sessions
- fixed Lucky getting stuck against Warp Block when entering new room
- changed spelling of this post to say "Patch"


More fixes! I also added a couple things that I've been meaning to, such as chest jumping penalties and health bars for the bosses (Show Stats needs to be enabled to see them). Have fun in the chambers!

Changelog
- Added health bar for bosses when Show Stats is enabled in Settings
- Changed Room 1 exit door to be closed when looping
- Changed loot drops when looping
- Fixed Room Captain gift getting stuck in corners
- Added something when player skips a chest
- Changed Octo to drop ink where it dies
- Fixed polls breaking after using multiple Warp Zones
- Fixed gizmos going off screen after going through a tube
- Fixed Room Captain poll not appearing if player jumps its chest
- Changed order of Event unlocks
- Decreased likelihood of Great Gizmo disappearing
- Changed Collect Gizmo to not bring you weapons
- Fixed Gizmo replacement logic when getting a Sub Gizmo
- Fixed Room Captain poll not appearing after dis/reconnecting channel
- Fixed player entering into challenge room via portal if coming from Warp Zone
- Fixed in-game timer to say 1:00 instead of 0:60
- Changed Starnose floor to be more descriptive of dangers below
- Fixed Hellfire power breaking game in shops, boss battles, and rooms with warps
- Fixed getting stuck in air if Roundleaf dies with player in his mouth
- Fixed Room Captain "enemy" gift spawning 2nd boss during boss battles
- Fixed resub counts to show more than just the ones digit
- Changed Gizmo poll to not appear if player already has maximum amount
- Fixed shop poll never ending if exiting room early
- Changed message box at top of screen to hide when inactive
- Fixed confetti getting stuck in the air

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks for all the feedback over the last 2 days. It's been a blast watching and playing with you in chat. I've taken care of most of the biggest issues, so hopefully things run a bit smoother. If you have any issues, the game's official Steam forums are the place to go.

A reminder that the Hall of Heroes Challenge is still live until Sunday night, July 19th! Get yourself immortalized in the game and get your own game made by me! Details here. Enjoy!

Changelog:
- fixed player resurrecting from game over if Gizmo clears the room
- fixed appearing during death animation when door opens
- fixed player getting stuck at Alpha intro
- fixed Boomer getting thrown too far
- fixed player stats not resetting after gameover
- fixed double jumping after touching a heart in the air
- fixed player getting crushed randomly
- fixed certain Kickstarter players not able to use Backer Powers
- changed Grid Room to stagger color blocks
- fixed Sub Collect Gizmos giving you enemies
- added helpful text during Alpha battle
- changed fireball death game over reason from "something" to "fireball"
- changed fireballs from pits to collide with Ground Gizmos
- stopped Collect Gizmo from collecting static items
- fixed Room 1 appearing abnormal when looping
- fixed Lightning strike getting stuck on screen
- added in-game dev support
- fixed two balls appearing if you rapidly click PLAY
- fixed exploit in Alpha battle
- updated chest text for Events
